LensPin FAQ

Do I need a GPX file?

No. Use geotagged iPhone photos, photos from another GPS-equipped camera, or an Apple Health / Fitness workout route from the same trip. LensPin does not record GPX.

Are my photos uploaded?

No. Photo matching runs on your device; your photos are not uploaded. See our privacy page for optional usage statistics and time-zone lookup details.

How much does it cost?

Free download. The first 100 photos/videos located are free. Saving a location to one photo or video counts as one use; skipped and failed items do not count. After that, LensPin Unlimited is an optional one-time purchase, with no subscription. See the App Store for the price in your region.

Does it change my original files?

No. Saving updates the Apple Photos library location. Optional JPG export creates a separate copy; original photo and video files stay unchanged.

Does LensPin import photos from my camera?

No. Import with Apple Photos, a card reader or the camera maker’s workflow first.
